clips.title: The story
paras: Priestess A'moora is a devout night elf servant of the Moon Goddess residing within the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Working closely under the guidance of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind's priesthood, she attends to rituals of spiritual purification and communion with Elune. Travelers exploring Teldrassil are often directed to her when matters involve sacred offerings and the mystical wildlife of the boughs.

Within the serene marble halls of the Temple of the Moon, Priestess A'moora spends her days in contemplation and service. As an ordained priestess of Elune, she assists in tending the spiritual needs of Darnassus and preserving the delicate rituals passed down through millennia. While much of the Sisterhood oversees military defenses or diplomacy, A'moora focuses on traditional devotions and sacred matters concerning the natural spirits of Teldrassil.

A'moora is tied to the sad fate of Lady Sathrah, a great spider once beloved of Elune whose silvery dew was kept in the temple for its healing powers. When Sathrah descended into madness, A'moora sent young adventurers to the northern borders of Teldrassil near Wellspring Lake to end her suffering and bring back her silvery spinnerets. Offered at the temple's fountain, the spinnerets become a sacrifice to Elune so that Sathrah might be reborn at peace.
